respuesta.razonamiento: Etion's automated multi-tenant CI/CD deployment pipeline allows developers to commit application and infrastructure code into AWS CodeCommit. CodePipeline orchestrates the flow through CodeBuild (which packages container images into Amazon ECR) and CloudFormation (which executes change sets to deploy ECS task definitions, IAM roles, and ALBs into customer VPCs).

nodes.notes: Stores application code and CloudFormation templates

nodes.name: CodeBuild

nodes.name: CloudFormation
nodes.notes: Uses change sets, approvals, and execution to deploy infrastructure

nodes.name: IAM
nodes.notes: Roles and permissions deployed per customer environment
